This page is part of the documentation site and is rendered to Typst, so the filter applies to it.

The links below are written relative, exactly as they are written on the HTML pages.
In this PDF they point at the published site instead, because nothing here can resolve them locally.

See [the reference](reference.qmd), [the examples](examples.qmd#rewriting-rules), and [the home page](index.qmd).

An absolute link, such as the one to [Quarto](https://quarto.org), is left alone, and so is a pure in-page anchor.

Compare the same three links on the HTML pages: there they stay relative, because the site can resolve them.
